name: Epic Souleater

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +6 Enhancement Bonus : +6 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Epic Trap the Soul
effects.tooltip: Epic Trap the Soul: This equipment stores an overwhelming, merciless power deep within. When you strike an enemy with a melee or missile attack, this power occasionally comes to the surface, sucking out the life force of an enemy and imprisoning the essence of their body and soul in a gem.

effects.name: Demonic Might
effects.tooltip: Demonic Might : This item gives the wearer the power of a demon, granting a +2 Profane bonus to Strength.

effects.name: Feeding
effects.tooltip: Feeding 20 : On Vorpal Hit : Your target incurs one Negative Level , and you gain +20 temporary hit points . (These Temporary Hit Points last for one minute, or until used to negate incoming damage.)

effects.name: Vampirism
effects.tooltip: Vampirism 2 : This weapon thirsts for the blood of your enemies, healing you for +2d2 hit points with each hit. Note: internal cooldown of 1 second.

effects.name: Negativity
effects.tooltip: Negativity 4 : This effect causes this weapon to be shrouded in dark mists, dealing 4d6 negative energy on each hit.

flavor_text: This is the staff used by the sahuagin High Priestess Slikir to commune with and channel a demon. It took on many of the demon's aspects and is now a dangerous and corrupted implement.
